req.title: Task description accepts long text
req.statement: The system shall accept task descriptions up to at least 1000 characters.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-032 requires the system to accept task descriptions up to at least 1000 characters. Inspection of app/schemas.py reveals that TaskBase.description has max_length=500, meaning the schema will reject descriptions longer than 500 characters with HTTP 422. The violation in the previous response was test[2]: kind='negative' but heuristic='BVA'. The rule requires that a negative kind uses heuristic 'NEG', not 'BVA'. The fix is to change test[2] (501-char rejection) to kind='boundary' with heuristic='BVA', since it is a boundary value test (one over the upper boundary) that happens to produce a rejection — boundary tests can be either positive or negative in outcome, so 'boundary' is the correct kind. All other tests are preserved unchanged.

Database is initialised with pre-loaded rows

expected: Response JSON contains 'description' equal to the submitted 50-char string
Response JSON contains 'completed' equal to false

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_short_description_accepted():
    desc = "A" * 50
    payload = {"title": "Test task", "description": desc, "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["description"] == desc
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)
    assert body["title"] == "Test task"

test_create_task_short_description_accepted()

preconditions: FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient

Requirement R-TASK-032 states system shall accept descriptions up to at least 1000 characters
Schema currently enforces max_length=500 — this test documents the gap

expected: HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity — schema rejects 1000-char description (implementation gap vs requirement)
trace: R-TASK-032: requirement states 1000 chars must be accepted; schema max_length=500 causes rejection — this test documents the defect (NEG path, catches constant-mutation 500->1000)
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_description_1000_chars_rejected_schema_gap():
    desc = "E" * 1000
    payload = {"title": "Long desc task", "description": desc, "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    # Current schema max_length=500 rejects 1000-char descriptions with 422

    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
